Definition: The presence and tier quality of commercial/colocation data center facilities operating in the country. Commercial data centers provide the physical infrastructure for hosting cloud services, content delivery, and enterprise applications domestically.
redteam_note: Scored >0 but NO source cited — unsupported claim, verify first. No data year recorded — provenance/recency unknown.
revision_notes: Confirmed: GITGE (Gestor de Infraestructuras de Telecomunicaciones de Guinea Ecuatorial) operates the country's sole commercial colocation facility, the Sipopo Datacenter near Malabo (colo.exchange and Data Center Platform directories, accessed 2026). No independent tier certification is published, but a single small facility is consistent with the Tier I-II band, so Value Code 2 is confirmed.

redteam_note: Scored >0 but NO source cited — unsupported claim, verify first. No data year recorded — provenance/recency unknown.
revision_notes: Confirmed low share: IEA reports renewables at 4.7% of electricity generation in 2023, and the World Bank's IEA-sourced indicator (EG.ELC.RNEW.ZS) shows around 8.8% for its most recent reported year. A third aggregator (countryeconomy.com) shows a conflicting 25-35% figure derived from installed-capacity assumptions rather than metered generation and is not treated as authoritative. Value Code 1 (<10%) confirmed.
